This Chili has won more Chili Cook Offs than any other Recipe Ever. #texas #chili #recipes #cooking  #creatorsearchinsights 

Transcript of the video's audio (machine-made):
In the last four years I've had over a thousand viewers report that they've won first place in either neighborhood, work or church chili cook off of this recipe. Today I'm gonna show you a couple of small changes. If you make these, you may not win first, but you may win first and second place. Let's get started. In this 10 quart pot, I'm gonna start with three pounds of ground beef. While the beef is cooking, I'm gonna add in about a tablespoon of my Washi's sister sauce. I'm also gonna add a six ounce can of tomato paste. One pound of breakfast sauces, this is Jimmy Dean Hot. One large white onion chopped. Two fresh jalapenos chopped, seeds and all. Three one ounce packets of Williams Original Chili Mix. Once all your meat is fully cooked, add in three 10 ounce cans of fire roasted rotel. One 15 ounce can of pateek diced tomato. A 29 ounce can of tomato sauce. One 15 ounce can of beef broth. One and a half tablespoons of freshly spooned garlic. Give everything a really good stir, then place the lid on on a medium low heat and let simmer for one hour. Then you wanna take and add in three of these 15 and a half ounce cans of Bush's Chili Magic Campfire Style. One and a half tablespoons of yellow mustard. Get everything stirred in really well. Place the lid on on a low heat and let simmer for a minimum of 30 more minutes. I already know I'm gonna add a splash of my zippy's after mine, what do you think about the new label?
